comparison.objective: Place a call button, tissues, and TV remote within reach of a stroke patient’s working hand; candidate finishes HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-object ergonomic placement and reach-side reasoning versus precise rigid-tool alignment, bimanual striking, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: All bedside objects are accessible to the working hand; no reach or placement thresholds provided. Candidate requires four safe fractures and all tangs contained.
comparison.reason: Accessibility-oriented arrangement is a different tested outcome from insert finishing.
